We pull data out of the tools they use to deliver care and run the business, unify and normalize the data, and then send it to the tools that need it.

about_short_description.short_description: Morf Health is a health tech platform that helps digital healthcare companies to collect patient information.

product.name: Custom Workflow Automation
product.description: A healthcare-specific platform that automates workflows by syncing and deduplicating patient data across tools to create tailored patient experiences and streamline clinical operations.

product.name: Optimize Conversion & Ad Spend
product.description: A tool that connects healthcare apps and data to track patient journeys, improve ad performance, and maintain HIPAA-compliant marketing analytics.

product.name: Personalized Patient Communication
product.description: A system that automates sending targeted, timely messages to patients via SMS or email to reduce no-shows and streamline pre-visit paperwork.

product.name: Seamless Patient Signup & Intake
product.description: A platform to streamline patient onboarding by creating branded, customizable signup and intake flows integrated with scheduling and EHR systems.
